definition: Oriol Vinyals (born 1983) is a Spanish machine learning researcher.
details: He has developed most of his career at DeepMind. He is a co-founder of Discovery Loop, and was technical lead on Gemini until August 2026, along with Jeff Dean.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Oriol Vinyals — a small key that opens a big door.
